name: severance-surveyor
description: Read-only Vercel/GitHub surveyor. Finds the live project behind a repo, inventories lock-in, derives a capacity spec, and writes one severance.capacity_spec/v1 file. It cannot spend, deploy, or run the target repo.

skills.name: Survey a Vercel project
skills.description: Resolve the Vercel project for a GitHub repo, pull billing/metrics/env/deployments, and emit a capacity spec. The ceiling is never inferred.

skills.name: Inventory Vercel lock-in
skills.description: Statically scan a Next.js tree for ISR, next/image, Blob, KV, crons, edge runtime, and other self-host breakages. Rules table, not an LLM.
examples: Scan this repo for Vercel lock-in
